module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Liquidity Provider Partial Fill (50% Block Filled)
precondition: Master sends 10.0 lots across 10 equal sub-accounts; LP only fills 5.0 lots.
steps: 1. Broker bridge returns partial fill execution report of 5.0 lots.
expected_result: MAM engine apportions the 5.0 filled lots proportionally (0.50 lots per sub-account); remaining 5.0 lots remain working or cancel per TIF.
actual_result: Partial fill handled proportionally: 5.0 lots filled yields 0.5 lots per sub-account. Remaining 5.0 lots remain working or cancel.
